canonical_owner.import_boundary: stdlib-only; hcli.persist imports no hcli or tools module

duplicate_evidence.measurement_method: Each tracked HEAD function was extracted with Python AST before editing. Raw source hashes retain the original local name; normalized AST hashes replace only that FunctionDef name before hashing.

preserved_contract.json_object_reader: Path.read_text(encoding='utf-8') then json.loads; return None for OSError, UnicodeError, JSONDecodeError, or any non-dict root. It adds no size cap, replacement decoding, file-type precheck, schema validation, or retry.
preserved_contract.optional_digest: Open the supplied Path in binary mode, update SHA-256 in exactly 1 MiB chunks, return the lowercase hexdigest, and return None for every OSError. It adds no size, symlink, time, or file-type policy.
preserved_contract.consumer_surface: Each consumer retains its former private helper name as a direct import alias, so local call sites and any accidental same-process attribute lookup keep the same callable contract.
preserved_contract.separate_contracts_retained: Capped or replacement-decoding readers, prefix digests, and raising hashes were deliberately left under their existing owners because their error and admission policies differ.

excluded: hcli/agentos/handoff.py::_read_object: 16 MiB cap and replacement decoding
hcli/architecture.py::_load_json, hcli/resident.py::_read_json, and hcli/agentos/fpga_preboard.py: distinct input and failure contracts
hcli/agentos/autonomy_gate.py::_sha256 and hcli/tool_registry.py hashing: raising rather than optional failure behavior
tools/agentos/genesis_resident.py: standalone helper outside the HCLI import leaf

validation.pre_to_post_output_parity: A synthetic golden probe ran all 22 reader aliases on valid object, list, scalar, malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8, missing-path, and directory cases, and all 14 digest aliases on empty, >1 MiB-plus-tail, missing-path, and directory cases. The 210 post-change outputs matched the pre-change JSON exactly.
validation.focused_regression: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q hcli/tests/test_persist_identity_io.py: 38 passed in 0.12s.
validation.persistence_regression: The focused test plus hcli/tests/test_core_authorities.py completed as 60 passed in 0.20s, retaining the existing atomic-writer authority checks.
validation.focused_test_scope: Direct owner cases prove the fallback boundaries. Parametrized consumer assertions prove all 22 reader and all 14 digest names are direct canonical aliases and no longer local function definitions.
validation.syntax_and_diff: python3 -B -m py_compile on all 25 changed consumers and hcli/persist.py; git diff --check: passed.
validation.import_cycle_audit: Every migrated consumer already imported hcli.persist before this change; hcli.persist remains stdlib-only. Flash Next retains its existing relative .persist import.
validation.non_execution_boundary: The probe and pytest use only temporary files. They do not load a model, inspect a model lake, call a network endpoint, start or restart a daemon, or sample host accelerator state.

production_owner_and_consumers_before_re.interpretation: Two shared leaf functions and direct imports replace 36 local helpers; unused stdlib imports were removed where the extracted helper had been their sole use.

hermetic_regression_before_receipt.interpretation: The focused temporary-file test guards the owner contract and all consumer aliases without invoking their broader runtime workflows.

claim_boundary: This receipt proves one stdlib-only owner for the listed optional JSON-object and streaming SHA-256 contracts, plus static import identity and temporary-file output parity. It does not claim that all repository file I/O is unified; compatibility with capped, replacement-decoding, prefix, raising, or runtime-specific helpers; live gate outcomes; model identity; model behavior; accelerator behavior; daemon behavior; network behavior; or deployment.
